      <title>Thatch: Product Designer</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Design</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote (US)
</p>

<div class="job__description body"><div><h3 class="mb-4 text-xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-gray-900 sm:text-3xl md:text-2xl">About the role</h3><br><p class="mt-4">At Thatch, design is one of the defining traits that sets us apart. The healthcare experience in America has long been subpar, and the bar for quality design is low — we’re raising that bar, and with it, the entire health insurance industry.</p><br><p>As a designer at Thatch, you’ll craft beautiful experiences for the people using our product every day: businesses, their teams, and brokers. You’ll shape all aspects of design, including UI components for our design system, new products involving complex user interactions, and the overall strategy and vision of the design team. Your work will help create a better insurance experience that <strong>enables members to get the healthcare benefits they need while feeling calm, fulfilled, and liberated</strong>.</p><br><p>We’re looking for someone who can meet users where they are in their journey and inspire trust by delivering simple, beautiful, and well-crafted end-to-end experiences. You should be comfortable owning the entire design process, from UX strategy to product design and company branding.</p><br><div class="mt-10"><br><h3 class="mb-4 text-xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-gray-900 sm:text-3xl md:text-2xl">What you'll do</h3><br><ul class="ml-4 list-disc"><br><li>Participate in and shape every part of the product development process, from idea inception to production</li><br><li>Work cross-functionally with engineering, growth, product, sales, operations, and leadership to create incredible user experiences</li><br><li>Develop and maintain the design system and brand assets we’ll use across the company</li><br><li>Write design documentation and guidelines for internal audiences</li><br><li>Iterate on and improve our design standards, tooling, and processes</li><br></ul><br></div><br><div class="mt-10"><br><h3 class="mb-4 text-xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-gray-900 sm:text-3xl md:text-2xl">Background we're looking for</h3><br><ul class="ml-4 list-disc"><br><li>4+ years of experience in product design roles</li><br><li>Obsession with understanding and serving users and, ultimately, making their lives better</li><br><li>Demonstrated first principle thinking and mastery of fundamental design principles</li><br><li>Experience operating in ambiguous environments solving complex user problems</li><br><li>Ability to balance blue sky creativity and dedication to craft with bias to action</li><br></ul><br></div><br><div class="mt-10"><br><h3 class="mb-4 text-xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-gray-900 sm:text-3xl md:text-2xl">Experience we’d be particularly excited about</h3><br><ul class="ml-4 mt-4 list-disc"><br><li>Ability to read and/or write HTML, CSS, and JavaScript</li><br><li>Background scaling high growth technology companies in the past</li><br><li>Experience or interest in finance, healthcare, or benefits</li><br></ul><br></div><br><div class="mt-10"><br><h3 class="mb-4 text-xl font-extrabold text-gray-900 sm:text-3xl md:text-2xl">What to expect</h3><br><p>We want this process to be transparent, thoughtful, and reflective of the work you’ll be doing every day. Our goal is to learn how you think, collaborate, and create — while giving you a clear sense of the team, our culture, and how we work together. Here’s what the process looks like:</p><br><ul><br><li>30-minute video interview screen to talk through your background and interest in Thatch.</li><br><li>30 minute first-round video interview with the hiring manager to dive deeper into your experience, approach to design, and how you work.</li><br><li>30 minute video meetings to connect with two members of the team</li><br><li>60-minute video meeting portfolio review with members of the design team to walk through your projects, your process, and the impact of your work.</li><br><li>30 minute video meeting with our founder to discuss culture, values, and how we operate as a company.<br><br></li><br></ul><br><p>We aim to move efficiently while giving you space to share your thinking, ask questions, and get a real sense of what it’s like to work here.</p><br></div></div><div><br><div class="mt-10 text-base text-gray-500">&nbsp;</div><br><br><div class="mt-10"><br><h3 class="mb-4 text-xl font-extrabold text-gray-900 sm:text-3xl md:text-2xl">About Thatch</h3><br><p class="mb-4 text-base text-gray-500">We’re a fully distributed early stage company using technology to change the way America does healthcare. We’re a happy, friendly, high-velocity team. You can read&nbsp;<a class="font-medium text-indigo-600 hover:text-indigo-500" href="https://thatch.ai/company">more on Thatch here</a>.</p><br></div></div></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/thatch-product-designer">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/thatch-product-designer</a></p>
</description>

      <title>Fisher Associates, P.e., L.s., L.a., D.: Precast Design Engineer</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Design</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote Worker - USA   Infrastructure + Mobility
</p>

<div class="job-preview-details"><br><div class="vertical-padding"><br><div>Full-time</div><br></div><br><div class="job-listing-header">Description</div><br><div><p><strong>Precast Design Engineer - Civil/Structural</strong></p><p><br></p><p><strong>Join Our Team as a Precast Design Engineer – Innovate and Lead in Concrete Design</strong></p><p><br></p><p>Are you ready to take your engineering career to new heights? Fisher Associates is seeking a skilled Precast Design Engineer to join our dynamic team, where your expertise in designing precast concrete components will make an impact on diverse civil and structural projects.</p><p><br></p><p>Join Fisher Associates and bring your talents to a team that values innovation, collaboration, and your unique contributions. Apply now to advance your career and play a key role in impactful projects within a supportive and dynamic environment!</p><p><br></p><p><strong>About Fisher Associates</strong></p><p>At Fisher Associates, we are a multidisciplinary design services firm with nine locations nationwide. Our services span civil/site engineering, transportation engineering, electrical engineering, landscape architecture, architecture, planning, environmental services, land surveying, GIS, construction inspection, precast, and construction engineering, each offering opportunities to shape communities and improve lives.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>What You’ll Do as a Precast Design Engineer</strong></p><ul><li>Lead and execute precast engineering and design tasks efficiently.</li><li>Collaborate with project teams to deliver structurally sound, cost-effective, and visually appealing precast concrete designs.</li><li>Perform and review structural analysis and calculations to ensure safety under various loads and conditions.</li><li>Select materials and components for precast concrete production that meet strength, durability, and sustainability standards.</li><li>Create accurate drawings, plans, and specifications for precast projects aligned with industry design standards.</li><li>Support cost estimation for materials</li><li>Support Project Managers and Designers throughout the project lifecycle.</li><li>Promote, utilize and support QA/QC processes to guarantee quality deliverables.</li><li>Guide and mentor junior staff.</li></ul></div><br><div class="job-listing-header">Requirements</div><br><div><p><strong>What You Bring, Your Expertise as a Precast Design Engineer</strong></p><ul><li>B.S. degree in Civil Engineering or a related field, Master’s preferred</li><li>5 -10 years minimum Precast concrete design engineering experience</li><li>Experience in precast concrete design engineering for transportation infrastructure and underground structures (utility vaults, manholes, drainage structures and pump stations) preferred</li><li>Familiarity with ACI 318, ACI 350, ASCE-7, AASHTO</li><li>Familiarity with IBC codes a plus</li><li>Professional Engineering License (PE) preferred or ability to obtain it</li><li>Proficiency in AutoCAD &amp; RISA 3D</li><li>Professional performance aligned with Fisher’s Mission, Vision, and Core Values</li><li>Dedicated to fostering trusting relationships through collaboration, integrity, respect, and active listening</li><li>Proven ability to deliver quality work through critical thinking, problem-solving, and sound judgment</li><li>Proactively own projects, prioritize effectively, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced, growth environment.</li><li>Superior organizational and planning skills with keen attention to detail</li><li>Curious and improvement-minded, embracing feedback and continuously seeking better solutions.</li></ul><p><strong>Why You’ll Love Working at Fisher</strong></p><ul><li><strong>You are empowered </strong>to achieve exceptional results through collaboration and leadership of multidisciplinary design teams.</li><li><strong>Your voice </strong>matters in our inclusive culture, where accessible leadership welcomes ideas and feedback.</li><li><strong>Your growth </strong>is our priority, supported by clear career paths and leadership opportunities.</li><li><strong>You thrive</strong> in a culture that keeps work engaging and fosters a relaxed, easy-going atmosphere.</li><li><strong>Your journey</strong> is supported by a team-driven environment that promotes mentorship and ongoing learning.</li><li><strong>Your success</strong> is supported by a flexible work environment so you can thrive professionally and personally.</li></ul><p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p><p><strong>Your Impact Matters, Your Career Thrives.</strong> Create meaningful community impact through engaging precast engineering projects while advancing your career. We offer competitive salaries and benefits, including:</p><ul><li>Medical, Dental &amp; Vision Insurance</li><li>401(k) Plan</li><li>Company-paid Life and Disability Insurance</li><li>Hybrid Work Schedule</li><li>Generous PTO and Paid Holidays</li><li>Strong Work-life Balance</li><li>Shareholders Program</li><li>Professional Development Opportunities and Reimbursement</li><li>Supplemental Benefits Designed for Total Well-being and Financial Security</li><li>Engage with a variety of employee groups focused on community, inclusion, and employee voice.</li></ul><p><strong>Salary Range</strong> $83,000-$105,000</p><p><br></p><p><em>Actual compensation may vary based on relevant experience, qualifications/education, and other factors. The salary range is not necessarily reflective of the actual total compensation that may be earned nor promise any specific pay for any specific employee. Salary range excludes monetary value of benefits.</em></p><p><br></p><p><strong>Equal Employment Opportunity Statement</strong></p><p>Fisher Associates is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where all individuals are respected, valued, and empowered to thrive. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected status under federal, state, or local law.</p><p><br></p><p>#LI-Remote</p></div><br><div class="job-listing-header">Salary Description</div><br><div>$83,000 - $105,000 annually</div><br></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/fisher-associates-p-e-l-s-l-a-d-precast-design-engineer">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/fisher-associates-p-e-l-s-l-a-d-precast-design-engineer</a></p>

      <title>Fullscript: Senior Product Designer (Clinical Education Platform)</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Design</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Toronto, ON / Austin, TX / Canada Remote / USA Remote
</p>

<div class="content"><div class="section-wrapper page-full-width"><div class="section page-centered"><div><b><span>About Fullscript</span></b></div><div><br></div><div>We’re an industry-leading health technology company on a mission to help people get better. We started in 2011 with one simple idea. Make it easier for practitioners to access the products they trust so they can deliver better care.</div><div><br></div><div>That simple idea grew into a platform that powers every part of care. Today, more than 125,000 practitioners use Fullscript for clinical insights, lab interpretations, patient analytics, education, and access to high-quality supplements. Over 10 million patients rely on Fullscript to stay connected to their care plans and follow through on treatment.</div><div><br></div><div>We build tools that make care smarter and more human. Tools that save time, simplify decisions, and help practitioners stay closely connected to the people they care for. When everything they need is in one place, they can focus on what matters most: <i>helping people get better.</i></div><div><br></div><div><b><span>This is your invitation.</span></b></div><div><br></div><div>Bring your ideas, your grit, and your care for people.</div><div>Join us and shape the future of care.</div><div><br></div><div><b>Fullscript Academy </b>is an education platform designed to support healthcare providers in delivering effective whole person care through evidence-based ingredient education and advanced diagnostic training. We deliver education through a variety of formats, including courses, webinars, articles, clinical guides, and in-app resources to support real-time clinical decision-making.</div><div><br></div><div><b>The Role</b></div><div><br></div><div>We’re looking for a <b>Senior Product Designer</b> to shape the future of clinical education on Fullscript Academy. You are a strong product designer first and foremost, with deep experience in user experience design and a sharp eye for creating beautiful, intuitive interfaces that reduce complexity. You design with a high standard of craft, creating experiences that feel credible, modern, and appropriate for a clinical, professional audience.</div><div><br></div><div>You have experience designing products that support learning, not just usage. You understand how to design for comprehension, retention, motivation, and long-term behavior change, and you know the difference between helping a user complete a task and helping them truly understand something.</div><div><br></div></div><div class="section page-centered"><div><h3>What You’ll Do:</h3><ul class="posting-requirements plain-list"><ul><li>Support seamless provider journeys across onboarding, content discovery, and course enrollment.</li><li>Design experiences that help providers understand and retain clinical knowledge, stay motivated over time, and apply learning with confidence.</li><li>Go beyond a single surface by creating the connective tissue between Academy and the broader Fullscript product ecosystem, ensuring context carries across experiences and learning naturally transitions into action.</li><li>Lead nimble, iterative UX research and testing to validate ideas, experiment with interaction patterns and information architecture, and refine solutions in a fast-moving environment.</li><li>Translate user insights, behavioral data, and product strategy into clear, thoughtful design direction.</li><li>Partner closely with Engineering to deliver high-quality, well-documented designs, adapt to technical constraints, and collaboratively refine scope and solutions.</li><li>Collaborate with clinicians and content leaders to shape new educational formats, deeply understand learning objectives, and design experiences that reduce complexity while preserving clinical nuance.</li><li>Contribute to scalable patterns that maintain clarity, credibility, and consistency across Academy.</li></ul></ul></div></div><div class="section page-centered"><div><h3>What You Bring:</h3><ul class="posting-requirements plain-list"><ul><li>Strong product design craft across user experience research, user experience design, and visual design.</li><li>Experience designing digital products end to end, from discovery and concept development through stakeholder alignment, prototyping, and developer handoff. </li><li>Experience working closely with engineering teams, adapting to technical constraints, refining scope collaboratively, and delivering clear, production-ready design files.</li><li>Experience designing for learning, behavior change, or knowledge retention outcomes.</li><li>Experience working across connected surfaces or product ecosystems.</li></ul></ul></div></div><div class="section page-centered"><div><h3>Bonus if you have experience with:</h3><ul class="posting-requirements plain-list"><ul><li>Professional EdTech platforms</li><li>Digital onboarding or academy-style products</li><li>Financial education or financial literacy tools</li><li>Knowledge or learning-enhancement platforms (e.g., AI note-taking tools)</li><li>Healthcare experience is a plus, but not required.</li></ul></ul></div></div><div class="section page-centered"><div><h3>What we can offer you:</h3><ul class="posting-requirements plain-list"><ul><li>Generous PTO and competitive pay&nbsp;</li><li>Fullscript’s RRSP/401k  match program for financial health&nbsp;</li><li>Flexible benefits package and workplace wellness program</li><li>Training budget and company-wide learning initiatives&nbsp;</li><li>Discount on Fullscript catalog of products&nbsp;</li></ul></ul></div></div><div class="section page-centered"><div><b>Compensation range</b></div><div><br></div><div>The salary range for this role is between $115,000 and $145,000 CAD. Fullscript shares salary ranges to support transparency and help candidates make informed decisions. The range shown reflects base salary only and does not include stock options, wellness stipends, or other benefits that are part of Fullscript’s total rewards package.</div><div><br></div><div>Final compensation depends on experience, skills, and location. We review pay regularly to stay aligned with market data and internal equity. Benefits and total rewards may vary by region.</div><div><br></div><div><span><b>Why Fullscript</b></span></div><div><br></div><div>Great work happens when people feel supported, trusted, and inspired. At Fullscript, we stay curious and keep finding smarter ways to make care better. We grow together, take on new challenges, and focus on impact. We put people first, work as a team, and leave egos at the door.</div><div><br></div><div><span><b>What to Know Before You Apply</b></span></div><div><br></div><div>We’re grateful for the interest in joining Fullscript. To make sure your application reaches our hiring team, please apply directly through our careers page. We’re not able to respond to individual messages about open roles on email or social channels.</div><div><br></div><div>Fullscript is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive workplace. Accommodations are available upon request at <a class="__cf_email__" href="/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection">[email&nbsp;protected]</a>.</div><div><br></div><div>All offers are contingent on successful background checks conducted in compliance with federal, state, and provincial laws.</div><div>We use AI tools to support parts of the hiring process, including screening and reviewing responses. Final hiring decisions are always made by people and follow all applicable privacy and employment laws in Canada and the U.S.</div><div><br></div><div><span><b>Learn More</b></span></div><div><br></div><div><a href="http://www.fullscript.com/">www.fullscript.com</a></div><div><a href="https://www.instagram.com/fullscripthq/?hl=en">@fullscriptHQ</a> on instagram</div><div><a href="https://youtu.be/ebcF2Vz3xf8">Let’s make healthcare whole</a>&nbsp;</div><div><br></div></div><div class="section page-centered"><div class="text-small italic text-gray-700">We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.</div></div></div></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/fullscript-senior-product-designer-clinical-education-platform">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/fullscript-senior-product-designer-clinical-education-platform</a></p>
